confidence_levels.integration_proven: Covered by encrypted integration tests but not yet by the complete native UI path.
confidence_levels.static_recovered: Recovered from the exact-live retail image or generated type information.
confidence_levels.inferred: Best current explanation; requires a discriminating native experiment.
confidence_levels.unknown: Code or shape is observed, but semantic ownership is not established.
confidence_levels.rejected: A bounded experiment contradicted this interpretation.

application_service:0x041c.limits: The exact-live executable proves the wire type, required-field validator, serializer and empty response boundary. Live traffic proves client acceptance of empty replies, but no original server capture assigns field-1 semantics. Do not use it as a preparation, room, player or reward identifier without new evidence.

extra_entries.name: REQUEST_REGISTER_PLAYER
extra_entries.summary: Player-registration request recovered from the exact executable. Trigger and application-field meanings remain unqualified; no handler was added.
extra_entries.payload: Required string field 1, uint32 fields 4/5/6 and uint64 field 7. Builder 0x018316f8 assigns opcode 0x038e; serializer 0x018fdf08 identifies the field tags and widths.
extra_entries.limits: In the traced constructor, field 7 is a 16-bit value or constant 108, not a general wallet value. Do not use its width alone to invent a cash migration contract. No message_type 910 was found in the current public log.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_INTRA_FACTION_BRIEFING_TEXT
extra_entries.summary: MatchingResult field 9 true selects category 7 and the intra-faction Practice Battle notice in Normal Extermination.
extra_entries.payload: Field 9 reaches task+0x6b8. The branch at 0x00f383c0 selects category 7, which constructor 0x0023e7e8 stores at record+0x10. Reader 0x0023e4f0 uses region*100+90+side for category 7. BriefingTextParam rows 190/191 through 790/791 select notice 56330. Local c438fb7 derives this from current factions; 946 tests pass. Native room 41 changes only field 9, replaces Practice Battle with Sirius/Venide directives, and completes shared gameplay/debrief/World with rejected settlement. The separate grace-period ticker remains unresolved despite code-2 world replies. Field 8 stays zero; its full enum is not recovered. Not deployed.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_BATTLE_TYPE_MAP_BUILDER
extra_entries.summary: MatchingResult field 4 selects the battle type. Native type 1 is Extermination; types 2/3 are paired Data; type 4 includes attacker-only Data; type 5's tested upper-level branch is Search-and-Destroy.
extra_entries.payload: r4 selects a WorldAreaBattleMapParam row, r5 the level, and r6 the mode. Type 5 selects row+0x30 TotalDestructionMissionID at level <=3 or row+0x34 DestroyTargetMissionID above 3. The region-3 upper branch loads ch3292/onlinemap3210, Samir Canyon, with 15 targets and a two-minute limit. Type 6 uses BossBattleMissionID and has a distinct outer region-source branch. Its tested Emergency mission loads Ratona Naval Port/ch3290, m3200 geometry, and onlinemap3204, with a ten-minute limit. Both attacker-side controls reach gameplay/loss/debrief/World with rejected settlement. Each other released peer creates a separate room and fails before Briefing. Neither control uses a layout read or room handoff. Type-5 lower-level, one-team assignment, larger-roster, reward, and player-facing Team Special qualification remain open.

extra_entries.name: PRESET_LAYOUT_RESOURCE_READER
extra_entries.summary: Formats a preset-layout path and copies 0x420 bytes only when the resource read succeeds. Not proven to cause the Data Hijacking failure.

extra_entries.name: PRESET_LAYOUT_SELECTED_AND_FALLBACK_READ
extra_entries.summary: Tries the task's selected short ID then an ID constructed from 0x0b, using destination pointer +0x14. Static fallback does not prove the live load fails.

extra_entries.name: PRESET_LAYOUT_TASK_AND_COMPLETION_CHAIN
extra_entries.summary: Schedules the preset read into owner+0x190 and an owner-bound completion callback at 0x00709308. Exact live Mock owner remains to be identified.

extra_entries.name: WORLD_BASIC_INFO_SERIALIZER
extra_entries.summary: Serializes WorldBasicInfo including optional repeated uint32 fields 5 and 6 omitted by the current server; gameplay semantics remain unknown. Vanilla patch.bnd restored previews and Far East/Middle East combat with these fields still absent, so omission is not established as the map defect.
extra_entries.payload: Decoded arrays +0x50/+0x54 and +0x70/+0x74 copy through 0x01855ce0 to native arrays +0x688/count+0x6ac (capacity 8) and +0x6b0/count+0x6f4 (capacity 16).

extra_entries.name: STORY_MEMBER_SESSION_OPEN
extra_entries.summary: Empty-body opener for the captured Story/mercenary NXR exchange.
extra_entries.when: Immediately after both peers enter the RPCN room.
extra_entries.timing: Reference time t=0 for the captured NXR exchange.

extra_entries.name: STORY_SESSION_DATA
extra_entries.summary: Two observed room/session structures; the first includes the mercenary identity and match attributes.
extra_entries.when: Immediately after f204 and before periodic identity/status polling.
extra_entries.timing: First structure arrived 87-98 ms after f204; second arrived about 0.90-1.09 seconds after f204.

extra_entries.name: STORY_SESSION_DATA_ACK
extra_entries.summary: Empty-body acknowledgement following the initial f218 structure.
extra_entries.timing: Observed 106-119 ms after f204, about 19-21 ms after the first f218.

extra_entries.name: STORY_IDENTITY_STATUS_POLL
extra_entries.summary: Poll containing count 2 and the two fixed-width RPCN identities.
extra_entries.when: Every approximately four seconds while the shared Story room is unresolved.
extra_entries.timing: First poll begins about 3.50 seconds after f204; subsequent polls repeat every 4.00-4.01 seconds.
extra_entries.payload: 02, then two records beginning 01 followed by the fixed-width NPID.

extra_entries.name: STORY_IDENTITY_STATUS_RESULT
extra_entries.summary: One-byte validation status for f20a; 00 permits the employer to continue to the later briefing-member check, while 01 leaves that validation pending/blocked.
extra_entries.timing: Observed response latency is about 9-18 ms. It repeats at the same four-second cadence as f20a.
extra_entries.payload: The host UDP datagram is 21 bytes: a 6-byte RPCS3 virtual-P2P header plus the 15-byte guest datagram, whose trailing bytes are ff 4e 58 52 56 03 f2 22 followed by the one-byte result. Native result 00 reaches a later member/readiness check; it is not a false/not-ready boolean. Transient result 01 blocks that advancement and leaves both clients waiting. The traced resolver uses 0/1/2 status paths, with exact enum labels still inferred.

extra_entries.name: AC_IDENTIFIER_INDEX_LOOKUP
extra_entries.summary: Scans the five local AC entries for an identifier match and returns the matching index or -1 after exhausting the collection.
extra_entries.when: The hired mercenary initializes its Story/Briefing AC member record.
extra_entries.payload: No wire payload. The exact-live routine obtains each candidate through collection virtual methods and compares its identifier with the requested identifier through 0x01A6B3A4.

extra_entries.name: TYPED_SERVER_PUSH
extra_entries.summary: Outer envelope used for typed asynchronous server pushes.
extra_entries.payload: The body starts with a big-endian wire type. Exact ELF factory recovery: wire 7 is ChangeSessionHost, wire 8 is JoinSessionMember, and wire 9 is LeaveSessionMember. The server API numbers these as 8, 9, and 10. Neighboring type names do not prove dispatch order.
extra_entries.limits: The outer envelope has native proof. The corrected type mapping has exact-executable evidence; member identifier semantics and complete lifecycle behavior require separate native controls.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_SESSION_LEAVE_TASK_START
extra_entries.summary: Live controller vtable slot +0x34 allocates operation 0x0c and starts the asynchronous teardown task.
extra_entries.payload: The 0x130-byte task stores operation 0x0c at +0x1c and its caller-supplied reason at +0x128. Normal room 183 preserved reason 0xff000023.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_SESSION_WRAPPER_TEARDOWN
extra_entries.summary: Unique producer of Normal's observed leave reason 0xff000023.
extra_entries.payload: Locks a two-handle wrapper, selects handle +0x08 when +0x04 is absent, and invokes the selected controller's virtual slot +0x34 with 0xff000023.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_MEMBER_STATE_THREE_TRANSITION
extra_entries.summary: Member vtable slot +0x24 evaluates 0x0155d720 and marks the selected host/self member state 3 at 0x0155d9ac when the gate returns false.
extra_entries.timing: Normal's two-member vector is stable for about 2.1 seconds before this transition targets the host/self member.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_MEMBER_STATE_RESET
extra_entries.summary: Resets the selected member state to zero; the exact state store is 0x0155e05c.

extra_entries.name: BATTLE_MEMBER_VECTOR_EVICTION
extra_entries.summary: Decrements the distinct controller battle-member vector after the zero-state member has been replaced with the final entry.
extra_entries.payload: Observed Normal count transition is 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> 1 -> 0; the first removed entry is host/self and the remote is temporarily retained.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_LEAVE_MEMBER_DRAIN_WORKER
extra_entries.summary: Iterates every battle member after leave starts and schedules member token 0x25 through 0x0155e458.
extra_entries.payload: The scheduled value is 0x8001000100000000. This explains later member-state changes and vector drain but does not initiate failure.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_OUTGOING_SCREEN_FINALIZER
extra_entries.summary: Normal owner outgoing-screen finalizer that writes application state 5 -> 1 before controller state 4 and roster drain.
extra_entries.payload: At 0x00e7a4f8 it calls wrapper finalizer 0x01a6d874, which invokes the live +0x08 controller's slot +0x34 with 0xff000023.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_INTERNAL_EVENT_7_HANDLER
extra_entries.summary: Envelope byte +4 becomes r25; value 1 selects the non-owning wrapper branch at 0x00e7fa64.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_SESSION_WRAPPER_ASSIGNMENT
extra_entries.summary: Copies event 7's temporary wrapper into application +0x60; the failing value contains only controller handle +0x08.

extra_entries.name: INTERNAL_EVENT_QUEUE_ENQUEUE
extra_entries.summary: Enqueues application events into singleton queue 0x02237198.
extra_entries.payload: Copies the source at 0x016018dc and increments count at 0x01601bfc while r21 retains the source pointer.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_CONTROLLER_LOCAL_COMPLETION_PREDICATE
extra_entries.summary: Controller vtable slot +0xd4 evaluates local controller creation before scheduling boolean-1 event 7.
extra_entries.payload: Returned true with only the local member present about 19.4 ms before RoomInfo publication. Delaying it even only for Normal breaks room creation and immediate guest retention, proving this is required local completion rather than two-member readiness.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_LOCAL_COMPLETION_SCHEDULER
extra_entries.summary: Calls slot +0xd4 and, when it succeeds, schedules callback 0x01545850 through 0x015f234c.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_LOCAL_COMPLETION_EVENT_7_EMITTER
extra_entries.summary: Sets controller state +0x8c to 2, cancels scheduled work, and emits internal event 7 at 0x01545948.
extra_entries.payload: 0x01521cac constructs ID 7 with boolean 1 and controller key +0xf4 in event field +0x18.

extra_entries.name: SESSION_MANAGER_KEY_LOOKUP
extra_entries.summary: Resolves the event's controller key through the global session manager and returns a two-handle wrapper.
extra_entries.payload: Manager byte +0x88=1 searches the online active-controller list at +0x90 and returns handle +0x08. Byte 0 searches the owned list at +0x64 and returns +0x04. This manager flag is unrelated to member +0x88.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_SIGNALING_PREFLIGHT_RETRY_BARRIER
extra_entries.summary: After subtype-9 rebuilds both Compose screens, MatchingResult is withheld until both matched online IDs submit a fresh RegisterPrepare.
extra_entries.timing: The first retry emits game_match_signaling_retry_waiting; the second releases the preserved host/guest pair immediately.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_CONTROLLER_STATE_FOUR_CLOSE
extra_entries.summary: Writes controller state 4 after slot +0xe8 returns false and queues event 0x99 (or 0x95 from state 3).
extra_entries.timing: Observed after two members remained state 2 for about 1.84 seconds and about 54 ms before the first 0x041B report.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_CONTROLLER_SLOT_E8_LIMIT_PREDICATE
extra_entries.summary: Returns true only when controller+0x38 exceeds a nested 64-bit limit.
extra_entries.payload: Live failing operands kept the nested limit about 16,000 ticks ahead; the false result is downstream close classification, not the initiating timeout/member failure.

extra_entries.name: GAME_SEARCHABILITY_ENABLED
extra_entries.summary: Story owner event for the embedded operation labeled change game to searchable; working Story emits it twice and failing Normal never emits it.
extra_entries.payload: Normal uses a direct private RoomInfo handoff, so absence of this Story lobby-visibility event is not proven causal.
extra_entries.timing: The first Story owner event arrives about 392 ms after 0x07/0x0e/0x11/0x12.

extra_entries.name: DISPATCH_TYPE9_EVENT18_WORKER
extra_entries.summary: Sole producer of application event 0x18, selected by type 9 in dispatcher update 0x0163ec90.
extra_entries.payload: Reached through caller 0x0153e868 and factory 0x015a5cb0; normally emits when object+0x0c delegate slot +0x50 returns nonzero.

extra_entries.name: NORMAL_APPLICATION_SESSION_STATE
extra_entries.summary: Live Normal application/session state object with vtable 0x01ce57c0; the owner reaches state 5/mode 1 and the joiner state 1/mode 0.
extra_entries.payload: Vector begin/end/capacity are +0x44/+0x48/+0x4c. Field +0x50 is a nested substate, not member count. Controller wrapper is +0x60 with the controller pointer at +0x68.

extra_entries.name: STORY_APPLICATION_SESSION_STATE
extra_entries.summary: Parallel Story application/session state object with vtable 0x01ce5c48; a working owner is state 5/mode 1 and a working joiner state 1/mode 0.

extra_entries.name: APPLICATION_MODE1_STATE5_PROJECTION
extra_entries.summary: Common mode-1 state-5 projection/retention predicate called by update 0x00e7d898.
extra_entries.payload: Its non-owning controller path is 0x00e7bf04 -> 0x01a6db64 -> 0x0152e66c -> 0x0154bb08. A false observation is downstream of the outgoing-screen transition, not its cause.

extra_entries.name: APPLICATION_EVENT_SWITCH
extra_entries.summary: Common application-event switch: event 7 maps to case 4/0x00e7f788 and event 8 maps to case 5/0x00e7f690.
extra_entries.payload: Flag-1 branches 0x00e7fa64 and 0x00e7fa1c both resolve event+0x18 and assign the online controller wrapper to application+0x60.

extra_entries.name: MOCK_MAP_SELECTOR
extra_entries.summary: Eight UI-authoritative entries: New Frontier, Far East, Middle East, South Islands, Mid-Continent, South Frontier, North Frontier, Random.
extra_entries.payload: Only New Frontier shows Route N64/preview; the other named regions render NO DATA, but map step 1 still launches Ratona Naval Port (ch5100/onlinemap3200) on both clients.

rejected_interpretations.claim: 0x03D2 is ContinueMercenaryRegistration.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: it carries repeated target/message records and is SendMercenaryMessage; continuation is 0x03D4.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The 60-second registration continuation response should directly return an employer/job.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected by static callback recovery and native negative trials; successful continuation is an empty acknowledgement.

rejected_interpretations.claim: GetMercenaryData should return the decoded 26,120-byte garage AC snapshot.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: native profile open reports Could not retrieve mercenary profiles. The compact registered profile blob succeeds.

rejected_interpretations.claim: 0x03F0 is the missing subtype-9 team-session push discriminator.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected by a target-only native diagnostic; the client still did not emit RequestJoinTeamSession.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Reciprocal disconnected-member reports should invalidate both team-session members and send RemoveSession followed by profile refresh.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: exact subtype 6 then subtype 4 reached both clients, but neither emitted CheckValidPlayer/CreateTeamSession within 30 seconds or after Mock re-entry; central membership stayed empty.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Each CreateTeamSession should create a separate owner session and Join As Enemy should discover it through SearchTeamSession.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: unique sessions 50627/451473 were created, but Join As Enemy emitted no 0x03F0/0x03F1 or other application request and rendered no sessions.

rejected_interpretations.claim: 0x039B is a usable retail TradeParts request.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: adjacent names exist, but this retail registry has no type getter, TOC entry, or outbound builder.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Changing the one-byte response from 00 to 01 is the complete ready/success fix.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: PCAP-verified 01 suppresses the caution but leaves both clients waiting in Briefing and does not launch the mission.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The native 00 body is itself a false/not-ready boolean that causes the briefing-member caution.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: host watchpoints traced the byte through a 0/1/2 validation-status path. Native 00 advances to a later member check; forcing 01 blocks there and therefore suppresses both the later caution and mission launch.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Replacing the failed AC lookup result -1 with slot 0 completely fixes hired-mercenary Story missions.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: decompilation proves 0x00F1339C has exhausted all five identifier comparisons before returning -1. Substituting index 0 prevents the cur:-1 max:5 crash but preserves the underlying identity mismatch and leaves the later member check unresolved.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The Story failure is caused by absent or one-way same-host P2P traffic.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected after distinct-IP binding and PCAP proved sustained bidirectional SIGN and NXR traffic.

rejected_interpretations.claim: A valid guest context record plus RoomInfo field 1 equal to the guest's local prepare ID schedules JoinRoom.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected by a direct three-slot driver trace: MatchingResult ran, but neither the RoomInfo driver nor RoomInfo predicate ran before the guest created a second room.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Replaying MatchingResult after the local context key exists wakes the queued RoomInfo path.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the second push was deduplicated and produced no second factory, RoomInfo driver, or RoomInfo predicate read.

rejected_interpretations.claim: A different non-error downstream state code selects the guest RoomInfo/JoinRoom path.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: native traces for codes 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, and forced 7 all produced MatchingResult only and CreateJoinRoom. Static codes 5 and 6 are error-message paths.

rejected_interpretations.claim: A fixed post-RegisterPrepare settle delay lets both clients construct the correct role graph.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: 0.5 and 3 second delays retained the failure, while 10 seconds also prevented the selected host controller from being constructed.

rejected_interpretations.claim: RoomInfo only needs a game-frame processing gap before the guest MatchingResult.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a 0.5-second separation still produced a second CreateJoinRoom.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The guest has complete Join state and only the final Create-versus-Join vtable edge is wrong.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a process-local substitution of Create descriptor 0x01d89e10 with Join descriptor 0x01d89bb8 produced caution 00-31251 and no RPCN call; the original descriptor was restored.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Once cross-team legacy signaling is active, Normal Sortie learns the host RPCN room entirely through the same direct P2P path as Mock Battle.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected as sufficient: both clients activated signaling, but a bounded P2P-only guest release produced no JoinRoom and no captured NXR room handoff. The validated central RoomInfo plus signaling does produce a JoinRoom for the host's exact room.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal fails because its room searchable attribute 0x50 is -1 instead of Mock's valid value 100.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a conditional client patch made the real CreateJoinRoom request carry 100, but the NXR sequence and split briefing were unchanged. The patch was reverted and never distributed.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The all-FF scalar in Normal's first f218 prevents the later NXR transition.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a syscall-scoped replacement reached guest RAM as value 1, but produced no second f218 or f20a/f222 polling. The sender buffer was restored and the diagnostic removed.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Removing the temporary cross-team signaling overlay before MatchingResult restores enemy classification.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: both inverse subtype-8 pushes were delivered without killing NXR, but the enemy icon remained and the same split briefing occurred. The deployment was reverted.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Keeping the proven role pair in fields 4/5 and counterpart player/team in fields 6/7 supplies both room ownership and participant identity.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: an uninstrumented native replay crashed the guest while the host entered its solo briefing. The server payload and tests were restored.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal Sortie stalls because it omits Story's second f218 room/session structure.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a packet-level trigger sent the correctly sequenced 139-byte Story form 0.8 seconds after Normal's genuine f218. The joiner acknowledged it with f231, but still left the RPCN room after 41.05 seconds and reproduced the same participant caution.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The actual Normal attempt fails only because the signaling-preflight member overlay is stale or absent when MatchingResult is released.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: exact subtype-9 member pushes delivered immediately before release left both synthetic remote members at connected byte +0x88=0, they disappeared about 14 seconds later, and the guest still left room 178 after 33.16 seconds. The deployment was reverted.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Subtype-9 protobuf field 6 supplies the live member +0x88 role/readiness byte.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: field 6=true was delivered in an otherwise identical cross-team push, but both remote member +0x88 bytes remained zero. The candidate was reverted immediately.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Keeping synthetic cross-team session members present and forcing their +0x88 bytes ready is sufficient to build Normal's battle roster.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: reannouncement plus a 20-ms live watcher set both remote bytes to 1, but retail deliberately removed the overlay entries at the battle-session transition and the host retained the same participant teardown. The overlay is signaling bootstrap only.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Forcing the create-session initial-member predicate true prevents the post-briefing teardown.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: room 185 loaded the valid battlefield and followed the same teardown. The local YAML diagnostic was restored byte-exact.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Automatic Normal teardown enters through the session-class wrapper at 0x015d9570.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a live instruction trap at the wrapper did not fire while the host still reached Matching2 LeaveRoom. The live controller dispatches 0x01548520 directly through vtable slot +0x34.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Automatic Normal teardown is initiated by the create-task error handler at 0x0157b5cc.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the handler trap did not fire while the host still reached Matching2 LeaveRoom. The later leave-task chain is independently confirmed.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The missing custommap/0000_preset.layout fallback causes Normal's host teardown.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: working Mock probes the identical absent path eleven times and reaches shared Briefing. USRDIR/custommap does not exist on disc; the ENOENT is normal fallback behavior.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal fails because its NXR owner and joiner roles are reversed relative to working Story.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: in a fresh working Story control the RPCN owner sends f218/f20a and the JoinRoom peer sends f204/f231/f222. Normal has the same initial joiner-f204, owner-f218, joiner-f231 direction; it diverges in the owner's later internal state transition.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Fields 4-7 should carry recipient player/team and counterpart player/team IDs now that the single-room handoff is fixed.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the exact tuple made both clients call CreateJoinRoom again and no two-member battle roster formed. The candidate was reverted byte-exact after 128 candidate tests; the restored baseline has 127 passing tests and identical protected data.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The eight-byte event-7 record built at 0x016ed524 is the Normal application envelope selecting the non-owning wrapper branch.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the live pooled event is a larger object whose metadata after byte +4 persists while IDs change 40 -> 41 -> 7. The 0x016ed524 record zeros bytes 5-7 and has a different layout.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Delay every true slot-+0xd4 transition until its controller vector contains at least two members.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the shared scheduler also services the legitimate one-member Step-3 team-session controller, so the guard prevented login. All four local profile YAML/config files were restored byte-exact and both clients reached World Menu on the baseline.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Delay event 7 only for the Normal controller class until its vector contains two members, while preserving the Step-3 class unchanged.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the class discriminator preserved login, but the host looped CreateJoinRoom/LeaveRoom and raised 00-31251; the guest joined the released room and left after 0.51 seconds. Event 7 is required local controller-creation completion. The candidate was restored byte-exact and all protected manifests match.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal fails because its session wrappers contain only handle +0x08 instead of owned handle +0x04.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: both clients in a fresh working Story shared Briefing use the same 0x01d03448 controller class, retain two members, and exclusively use +0x08 wrappers. The owner has two state-2 members; the JoinRoom peer has self state 1 and remote state 2.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The outgoing screen's explicit controller-close call causes the host cancellation notice and guest preparation stall.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: bypassing only the close while preserving finalization kept both RPCN memberships alive and suppressed 0x041B, but the split UI was unchanged. The patch was restored byte-exact.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal fails solely because the local member's +0x7c byte is 0 instead of working Story's 1.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: the first probe promoted only remote and the second promoted only the true self member while leaving remote zero; both reproduced the same 0x041B teardown. Both diagnostics were reverted or cleared by restart.

rejected_interpretations.claim: The second guest MatchingResult immediately before RoomInfo resets the guest controller and causes Normal teardown.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: withholding the duplicate produced recipient_match_payloads={}, the guest still joined room 260, and the host emitted the same two 0x041B reports. The server/tests were restored byte-exact after 129 passing tests.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal teardown occurs because both teams request Enemy area (offense) instead of complementary offense and defense preferences.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: primary field 8=2 (Friendly area/defense) against secondary field 8=1 (Enemy area/offense) resolved the same coherent ch5100/m3200 battlefield and reproduced the identical roster teardown.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal needs Story's auxiliary value 2 instead of 0 for code 0x80000001 to select the correct session role.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a volatile pre-f218 write changed 0 to 2 in room 262, but the valid-stage attempt produced the same host member-canceled notice, guest join-session caution, and paired 0x041B reports.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal needs Story's auxiliary value 0 instead of 1 for code 0x80000006 to select the correct session role.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a volatile pre-f218 write changed 1 to 0 in room 263, but the valid-stage attempt produced the same host member-canceled notice, guest join-session caution, and paired 0x041B reports.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal needs auxiliary value 1 instead of 0 for code 0x8000000c before serialization, beyond the already-tested member +0x7c projection.
rejected_interpretations.result: Rejected: a volatile pre-f218 write changed 0 to 1 in room 264, but the valid-stage attempt produced the same host member-canceled notice, guest join-session caution, and paired 0x041B reports.

rejected_interpretations.claim: Normal registers dispatcher type 9, but its delegate returns false and suppresses event 0x18.
